definition: The running total of the frequencies: the number of data values less than or equal to a given value.
A graph of cumulative frequency plotted at the upper boundary of each class, with the points joined by a smooth curve, used to estimate the median, quartiles and percentiles.
The $p$th percentile is the value with $p\%$ of the data at or below it, so the $90$th percentile has $90\%$ of the values at or below it.
